runelessrpg_bridge.configuration.display:
Unit for all mana amounts you see.

Automatic (AUTO in the file): the unit of the leading mod, or of the one other bar you show.
Leading mod (LEADER): always the unit of the leading mod.
RunelessRPG mana (RUNELESS): always RunelessRPG mana.

runelessrpg_bridge.configuration.forward: Ars bar flashes for every failed cast
runelessrpg_bridge.configuration.askForM: Ask once at login which mana system leads: in singleplayer (and the LAN host) or an operator on a server, while Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks or Ars Nouveau is connected. Any answer turns this off; "Decide later" asks again at the next login. Packs that ship their config set this to false.
runelessrpg_bridge.configuration.manaSys:
Which mod's mana leads the shared pool. The leading mod keeps its own base max mana, regeneration and respawn rule; the others pay from its pool and add their bonuses to it. Changing it works at once without losing mana.

This screen can only change it in a singleplayer world that is not open to LAN. On a server or with LAN open, operators use /runelessrpg_bridge manaSystem <id>.
runelessrpg_bridge.configuration.manaDis: Which mana bar you see. It only changes the display, never the pool.
runelessrpg_bridge.configuration.value.s: Cannot lead right now: %s. The value stays in the file; RunelessRPG leads until it works.
runelessrpg_bridge.configuration.value.d: This mod is not installed: the bar of the leading mod is shown. The value stays in the file.

runelessrpg_bridge.ask.title: Which mana system should lead?
runelessrpg_bridge.ask.intro: All magic mods now share one mana pool. The mod that leads brings its own base max mana and regeneration; the bonuses of all mods still count.
runelessrpg_bridge.ask.hint: You can change it at any time with /runelessrpg_bridge manaSystem <id> or in the mod's config.
runelessrpg_bridge.ask.pack: Pack makers: set askForManaSystem = false in runelessrpg_bridge-server.toml to skip this question.
